newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs to jump 127.90 before 129.00 target.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs to jump 127.90 before 129.00 target.

text.p: June BTPs are in good shape technically and could push higher towards 129.00 near term, technical analysts said on Thursday.
But they will have to struggle through the 127.80,90 area first in trade that will likely be thin with most of Europe on holiday for May Day.

"The market is currently challenging the 127.84 resistance but with the buy signal in Stochastics we feel this will give way to project the market up to the 129.05 highs in due course," said Richard Adcock, technical research manager at HSBC Markets.
By 0801 GMT, the June BTP was up 0.07 at 127.69.
BTPs rose to a daily high of 129.05 on April 17.

Adcock said short term setbacks should be well supported down to 127.50, where further buying opportunities would be offered. Crane Investment Analysis director Adrian Sells noted the market had had problems lately around the 127.80,90 area.
Charts show the June contract stalled at a high of 127.84 on April 23 and again at 127.82 on April 24.
"We poked through that yesterday to reach 127.89, but on the whole that 127.80,90 area is a bit of an immediate barrier," he said.
"But it is possible we'll get ahead of that and potentially go back and test the highs back in mid April, all the way back towards 129.00," he added.
Sells put key support at the 127.50, 40 area. "That's the area which the market intraday established as a high prior to the late rally yesterday," he said. "We repeatedly came off the 127.50 area."
By 0816 GMT, June Eurolira was unchanged at 93.23.
